tools.name: get_spain_internet_plans
tools.description: Spain Internet's products for travellers to Spain (mainland, Balearic and Canary Islands), all with truly unlimited data on the Vodafone Spain network: an eSIM, a data SIM card, and 4G+ and 5G pocket WiFi hotspots. Returns each product's price tiers by trip length and what it includes. quote_spain_internet gives the exact price for given dates.

tools.name: quote_spain_internet
tools.description: The live price of one Spain Internet product for the traveller's dates, and a booking link with those dates already chosen. It does not pay or place an order: the traveller opens the link, picks delivery (physical products), continues to checkout, enters their details and pays. Dates are the first and last day the traveller needs internet, inclusive (a trip from 2 to 9 November is 8 days). The price is for one device; the quantity can be changed on the page. The SIM card and WiFi hotspots are delivered in Spain and need a few working days, so their earliest start date is later than today; the eSIM can start today.

product.description: esim, sim (data SIM card), wifi_4g (pocket WiFi 4G+) or wifi_5g (pocket WiFi 5G).

start_date.description: First day internet is needed, YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: Last day internet is needed, YYYY-MM-DD.
